Headers and utilities for internal use by OkHttp. 
 * @hide This class is not part of the Android public SDK API

variables.name: SENT_MILLIS
variables.comment: * Synthetic response header: the local time when the request was sent.

variables.name: RECEIVED_MILLIS
variables.comment: * Synthetic response header: the local time when the response was received.

variables.name: SELECTED_PROTOCOL
variables.comment:
* Synthetic response header: the selected
   * {@link com.android.okhttp.Protocol protocol} ("spdy/3.1", "http/1.1", etc).

variables.name: RESPONSE_SOURCE
variables.comment: Synthetic response header: the location from which the response was loaded.

methods.name: public static Map<String, List<String>> toMultimap(Headers headers, String valueForNullKey)
methods.comment:
* Returns an immutable map containing each field to its list of values.
   *
   * @param valueForNullKey the request line for requests, or the status line
   *     for responses. If non-null, this value is mapped to the null key.

methods.name: public static void addCookies(Request.Builder builder, Map<String, List<String>> cookieHeaders)
private static String buildCookieHeader(List<String> cookies)
methods.comment: * Send all cookies in one big header, as recommended by * RFC 6265.

methods.name: public static boolean varyMatches(Response cachedResponse, Headers cachedRequest, Request newRequest)
methods.comment:
* Returns true if none of the Vary headers have changed between {@code
   * cachedRequest} and {@code newRequest}.

methods.name: public static boolean hasVaryAll(Response response)
methods.comment:
* Returns true if a Vary header contains an asterisk. Such responses cannot
   * be cached.

methods.name: public static boolean hasVaryAll(Headers responseHeaders)
methods.comment:
* Returns true if a Vary header contains an asterisk. Such responses cannot
   * be cached.

methods.name: public static Set<String> varyFields(Headers responseHeaders)
methods.comment:
* Returns the names of the request headers that need to be checked for
   * equality when caching.

methods.name: public static Headers varyHeaders(Response response)
methods.comment:
* Returns the subset of the headers in {@code response}'s request that
   * impact the content of response's body.

methods.name: public static Headers varyHeaders(Headers requestHeaders, Headers responseHeaders)
methods.comment:
* Returns the subset of the headers in {@code requestHeaders} that
   * impact the content of response's body.

methods.name: static boolean isEndToEnd(String fieldName)
methods.comment:
* Returns true if {@code fieldName} is an end-to-end HTTP header, as
   * defined by RFC 2616, 13.5.1.

methods.name: public static List<Challenge> parseChallenges(Headers responseHeaders, String challengeHeader)
methods.comment:
* Parse RFC 2617 challenges. This API is only interested in the scheme
   * name and realm.

methods.name: public static Request processAuthHeader(Authenticator authenticator, Response response, Proxy proxy) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* React to a failed authorization response by looking up new credentials.
   * Returns a request for a subsequent attempt, or null if no further attempts
   * should be made.
